_comment: Display-name overrides for surah names (key = surah number). Only 'approved' entries are applied (Daily Post slide + caption, Reel overlay + caption); everything else shows the Quran.com API name unchanged. 'proposed' entries wait for the user's approval and are NOT applied. The ayah text itself is never changed. Scan of all 45 surahs used in the Daily Post and Reel lists: 2026-10-04.
